claim: Root move 4 proves that if the hive polytopes have the integer decomposition property then their h vectors are nonnegative, and that nonnegative h does not give the conjecture. The one question this makes decisive on data already held is whether any h vector has a negative entry. A single negative entry refutes nonnegativity for the family completely, and by the contrapositive of move 4 it also refutes the integer decomposition property for that polytope.
approved: independent review of 2026-09-05, ACCEPT WITH AMENDMENTS, eight amendments, recorded in ../../ADMISSION.md; the proposal was cut from four tests to this one

what was dropped and why.the asymmetry inequality: equivalent to the linear coefficient being nonnegative, which the box attack already certified on this data with two independent programs, so testing it can only return a pass
what was dropped and why.monotonicity: a statement about a nested pair of polytopes; no pairs were named
what was dropped and why.Hibi's lower bound: needs a lattice polytope with an interior lattice point and no decision was stated to hang on it

method: the box attack's certified-special-case-check-4/census.py, which already computes every h vector by the alternating sum of C(D+1,j) times P(i-j) and was independently checked, with three additions and no other change: the smallest entry of each h vector, the count of records with a negative entry by index, and the records that have one
what a nonnegative census would not mean: Stanley's theorem gives nonnegative h unconditionally for lattice polytopes, so every record whose hive polytope happens to be a lattice polytope carries no information, and this census cannot separate those from the genuinely rational ones without constructing the polytopes
certification caveat: a negative entry among the seven-part records rests on one solver and must be re-certified before it is claimed; lengths up to six are certified by two independent programs
allowance: one run of at most 20 minutes on the machine the original census used, trials counted; one checker run
retreat: a negative entry ends the classical-inequality route and returns the attack to the local-formula line with the triple recorded; an exhausted allowance means the covered prefix is reported as a prefix
